name: @platform/hq-api
description: The HQ API (stores, catalog, stock, purchasing): its own program, port and database, reaching the platform only over HTTP and its events. Holds HQ's copy of the brands today; features come from HQ's stories.

scripts.db:migrate: node ../../scripts/with-env.mjs prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/schema.prisma && pnpm db:generate
scripts.db:reset: node ../../scripts/guard-destructive-db.mjs && node ../../scripts/with-env.mjs prisma migrate reset --force --skip-seed --schema prisma/schema.prisma
